towns.name: Timaru
towns.summary: Timaru (44.2N 78.0W) is the capital of the Aun Tumeroks, who made peace with the Isparians, on the Marescent Plateau of Marae Lassel. The village sits on a smaller 30 m plateau (z 120) above the 90 m Marescent plateau, where Aun Firanauri the Gate Keeper guards the base and portals in only those the Aun xuta trusts. An octagon of dark stone-and-timber palisade walls with a domed gate tower encloses the great green-roofed hut (with chimney smoke), 24 m carved Aun totem frames, a circle of eight standing stones around a smouldering brazier, torches, crafters' stalls and the Town Network portal. West of the plateau a river runs in a deep gorge at z 26 and, 500 m south, pours over a 120 m wide weir bridge of stone piers down a 26 m waterfall into the Karab Delta lowlands, where a giant Aun head statue with red glowing eyes and torches (housing the Marescent Plateau Portal) stands at the cliff foot.
